author: kesudh
method: Independent cold-start driver-rooted shortest-path-tree portfolio: integer multi-goal A*, negotiated vertex-congestion construction, exact per-net delay descent, non-worsening local group rip-up/reroute; two cold starts per process, fixed seed and work counts.
hardware: Intel Core i7-13700HX (16C/24T), 31.7 GiB RAM, Windows 11
route_inputs: Only the benchmark instance JSON. No published routes, reference solutions, previous entry routes, learned weights, or case-specific routing settings.
runtime_scope: Wall-clock seconds of one complete solver process per case: launch, instance parse, both cold starts, construction, all polish/group moves, JSON serialization, file close, process exit. Excludes compilation, pre-run instance copying and post-run independent checking. No stages or seeds omitted.
algorithm_credit: PathFinder-style history/present congestion negotiation and standard shortest-path/LNS techniques; challenge grid and objective from m3d/grid.py and m3d/checker.py. New Rust implementation; no route geometry reused.
